(RS_TS_00013)
7.3.6.3 Rate Correction for Global Time Masters
Rate correction in Global Time Masters can be applied to Synchronized and Offset
Time Bases Resources.
Rate correction is applied by setting a correction factor which the TBR uses to cor-
rect the Time Base's time whenever it is transmitted over the network. This happens
independent of the rate correction done by the slave.
